Hi Elaine —

Congrats again on getting over the finish line. Attached is the initial execution playbook and Mutual Action Plan (MAP) tailored for PathosHealth. This embeds the post-signature implementation items we discussed: rollout phases, canary strategy, migration windows, and the training cadence for end users and admin teams.

Key highlights (high level):
- Phase 0 (pre-cutover): data sampling, mapping, and access checks (2 weeks)
- Phase 1 (canary): 2-week canary on non-critical cohort (2x weekly checks + KV cache validation)
- Phase 2 (ramp): progressive traffic increase to 50% then 100% across two weeks
- Training: two instructor-led sessions + on-demand recordings during ramp
- Eval plan: key prompt sets, latency & quality SLOs, and rollback triggers

Action items for Pathos: please confirm the canary cohort (suggest: 3 clinics) and provide the ops contact for the week-of-cutover war room.

I copied Monica (AM), Vivek (SE), and Grace (CS) to align on runbook details and training materials.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Alex / team — quick read: 48-hour freeze is workable with these adjustments. Summary below (will attach an edited runbook):

- Pre-freeze (T-7 to T-2): full KV cache population on a shadow namespace; full sampling of prompt sets; golden path smoke tests against staging.
- Freeze window (48hrs): only read traffic for EMR-connected flows; writes queued and replayed after freeze ends. Our runtime supports queued writes + guaranteed-order replay — documented in runbook.
- Canary week: start with clinic A (48hr observation), then clinic B/C in parallel if metrics stable.
- Rollback triggers: >5% regression on quality eval (A/B prompt set) OR latency P95 > 2.5x baseline for 6 consecutive hours.

Actionables:
1) I will update the Canary_Runbook.pdf with the queued-writes flow and replay steps by EOD today.
2) Need an ops contact for the war room (point person for replay approvals).
